comparison.objective: Candidate screens ceramic media from washers; PR fits and locks a suction tool onto a robot quick-change flange while leaving the other tool unused.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests controlled pouring, agitation, and selective passage; PR tests plate-to-dowel alignment, sustained support, and coordinated locking-ring actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires mass recovery, washer retention, no spill/damage, supported release, and 3 s dwell; PR requires the correct tool seated and locked at ≥25°, the wrong tool never locked, hands clear, and arms home for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Particle screening is meaningfully different from precision tool-flange mating and mechanical latching; the PR’s evolving seating tolerances remain sufficient to establish distinction.
